title: Midpoint normalisation factors (per person per year) for the single score

recipe_2016.factors_reported_not_in_score_note: Same workbook and column (World 2010, Hierarchist), rows 'Stratospheric ozone depletion', 'Ionzing Radiation', 'Photochemical ozone formation - Terrestrial ecosystems', 'Toxicity - Human health (cancer)', 'Toxicity - Human health (non-cancer)', 'Toxicity - Terrestrial ecosystems', 'Toxicity - Freshwater ecosystems', 'Toxicity - Marine ecosystems'. Used only to report normalised results for these categories; they are NOT in the equal-weighted sum, whose 10-category set is fixed so the calibrated bands (engine/single_score_bands.json) stay valid.
recipe_2016.score_label: Equal-weighted normalised midpoint sum (10 categories, ReCiPe 2016 World 2010 H normalisation). ReCiPe 2016 defines no official weighting or single score; this is a screening aggregate, not an official ReCiPe single score.
recipe_2016.source: ReCiPe 2016 v1.1 normalisation, World 2010, Hierarchist, midpoint; data/ReCipe2016/Normalization scores ReCiPe2016v1.1_20190514.xlsx, sheet 'Final normalization scores', column D (Hierarchist).
recipe_2016.caveat: Fossil depletion = crude oil + natural gas + hard coal + brown coal rows of the spreadsheet. The natural gas row reads 0.40 kg oil-eq/person/yr in the published file, which looks like a unit slip (crude oil reads 570); it is carried as published and flagged for review.

ef_3_1.category_names_note: Keys are the engine's display names. EF 3.1 names: Climate change; Ozone depletion; Human toxicity, cancer; Human toxicity, non-cancer; Particulate matter; Ionising radiation, human health; Photochemical ozone formation, human health; Acidification (terrestrial + freshwater accumulated exceedance, displayed as 'Terrestrial acidification'); Eutrophication, terrestrial; Eutrophication, freshwater; Eutrophication, marine; Ecotoxicity, freshwater; Land use; Water use (AWARE); Resource use, fossils; Resource use, minerals and metals.
ef_3_1.source: Normalisation: Andreasson J, Sala S et al. (2024) Updated characterisation and normalisation factors for the Environmental Footprint 3.1 method, JRC130796, EUR 31474 EN, Table 2 (global NF per person). Weighting: EF 3.0/3.1 weighting set including robustness, toxicity categories included (Sala S, Cerutti AK, Pant R (2018) Development of a weighting approach for the Environmental Footprint, JRC109878, EUR 28562 EN; carried unchanged into the EF 3.1 reference package). Not present in data/EVvinronmental_Footprint_EF3.1, which holds characterisation factors only.
ef_3_1.verification: Verified 2026-11-25 against data/AGRIBALYSE3.2/AGRIBALYSE3.2_partie agriculture_conv_PublieNOV25.xlsx (AGRIBALYSE 3.2, EF 3.1 adapted for SimaPro): for all 217 products, 1000 x sum(midpoint / NF x weight) reproduces the published 'Score unique EF3.1' (mPt/kg) with median relative error 0.01 % (max 4.5 %, rounding of published midpoints); an unconstrained least-squares fit of the 16 coefficients (weight/NF) agrees with these values to within 1 % for every category.
ef_3_1.score_label: EF 3.1 single score: sum over the 16 EF 3.1 categories of (midpoint / global NF) x official weight, in micro-points (1 Pt = 1 person-year, weighted).
